figurative_meaning_en: life-threatening or extremely exhausting hard work
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ঘাড়ভাঙ্গা খাটুনি করে পরিবারের সবাইকে ভরণপোষণ করে।
এই কাজটা ঘাড়ভাঙ্গা খাটুনি, কিন্তু আয় ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: He does neck-breaking hard work to support his entire family.
This job is neck-breaking labor, but the pay is good.
note: This idiom vividly captures the physical strain of manual labor in Bengali culture, often associated with agrarian or blue-collar efforts.
